name: Heather Bryan
residence: Natrona County. Oil City News reported that she told a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum that she is a Thermopolis native.
occupation: Natrona County treasurer-elect taking office in January 2027. Oil City News reported that she has served in the treasurer's office for 25 years and, at the time of the 2026 campaign, was deputy treasurer and chief deputy.
prior_offices: Natrona County treasurer's office: property tax clerk, bookkeeper, office manager, supervisor, deputy treasurer, and chief deputy (titles and sequence described in a June 8, 2026, Oil City News questionnaire and a July 9, 2026, Oil City News forum report)
background: Heather Bryan is the Natrona County treasurer-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Tom Doyle, who Oil City News reported had announced his retirement. In a June 8, 2026, Oil City News questionnaire she wrote that she has served in the treasurer's office for 25 years under two treasurers, began as a property tax clerk, and has held every position in the office, including office manager, bookkeeper, supervisor, and chief deputy. Oil City News reported that at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum she said she is a Thermopolis native and has served as deputy treasurer for the last five years. She ran unopposed in the November 2026 general election.
